text: Hello, really sorry to message so late, I know you must be busy with kids who are actually poorly. My son is 21 months. He was sick once earlier this evening, just the one time after his tea, and since then he's kept his drinks down. I've been giving him little sips of water and some of his milk and it's all stayed down so far I think. He's also got a sore throat, or I'm pretty sure he has, he keeps pointing at it and saying ow, but he's still drinking ok even with it hurting. My wife is on nights so it's just me and I'm not great at judging this stuff, she usualy handles it. I've put him back to bed and I'm sitting on the landing typing this. Is there anything I should be doing for the throat, or anything to watch out for? Sorry again for bothering you, I'm probably being silly
